title: How Can I Book a Group Flight Ticket on Arajet?
content:
Arajet is considered the largest low-cost airline. Also, it is the largest carrier in the Dominican Republic. Due to this, flying with this airline for any occasion becomes seamless and economical. Curating shared trips here is also as convenient as individual journeys because of its group travel option. This feature allows a bunch of travelers to fly under a single itinerary. Other than that, travelers planning Arajet Group Travel enjoy competitive fares, convenient seating, and a number of other privileges. With all these perks, their group gateway becomes compelling and more thrilling. Besides, insight into other factors related to group travel can be found below.

What Are the Group Booking Terms & Conditions on Arajet?

Arajet has certain rules for passengers traveling together under a group reservation. These guidelines cover the main requirements that need to be followed while arranging the Arajet Group Flight and help travelers understand the terms attached to the booking. Some conditions may also be included in the group quote shared for the proposed journey. Furthermore, a few general requirements can also be seen in the following points.

  • Group Size: A trip as a group can be created when 10 or more members seek to fly together.
  • Group Fares: The available group fares include Classic, Comfort, and Extra, depending on the selected option.
  • Passenger Names: Passenger details need to be provided within the allowed timeline, with names due at least 10 days before departure.
  • Group Size Flexibility: The size of the group is not necessarily fixed at the start, as additional travelers may be included when seats remain available.
  • Name Changes: Name details also come with some flexibility, as one name change is free for every 20 passengers under the group reservation.
  • Travel Changes: The group terms may restrict changes to the travel date, origin, destination, or travel class.

How can I book a group flight ticket on Arajet?

Travelers seeking to get several seats under the same flight on Arajet have an online option to submit their booking request. So, they can visit the airline’s website and access the relevant group travel form to share the information needed for their intended journey. This Arajet Group Booking request keeps the seats and passenger information in one place rather than managing multiple individual reservations. Furthermore, travelers can raise a group booking request with this channel anytime and from anywhere they want. Here are the steps to complete the group booking.

  • Open the official Arajet website to begin the group travel request.
  • From the homepage, select the “Groups & Charters” section.
  • Then, click “Quote Now” and set up an account to continue.
  • Further, enter the required journey and group information in the provided form.
  • Arajet will review the request and send a group quotation, which should be confirmed within its given validity period.
  • Next, complete the fare payment using one of the available payment methods.
  • Later, provide the passenger names exactly as shown on their travel documents.
  • After that, the group tickets will be sent to the registered email address.

Conclusion

So, multiple travelers can smoothly travel together on the same flight with Arajet. But to organize group journeys, travelers have to look at many important details and factors. Moreover, they can find the information regarding the same from the headings disclosed above. But if they want more clarity about group booking rules, process, benefits, and so on, they can directly contact the airline.
